blocks.text: HANOI – Less than a month after putting the plan up for public consultation, the local authorities have decided to go ahead with a massive redevelopment of the area around Hoan Kiem Lake in central Hanoi. On Oct 27, the Hanoi People’s Committee submitted an investment proposal worth more than 22 trillion dong ($855 million) to transform part of the city centre into a district that planners say would combine its cultural heritage with world-class modern features by 2029. At 66ha, the redevelopment zone covers a substantial area of Hanoi’s historic core, evoking Singapore’s Chinatown, with its conserved shophouses and distinctive […]...
